entries.title: Psalms 25:1
segments:
. The general tone of this Psalm is that of prayer for help from enemies. Distress, however, exciting a sense of sin, humble confession, supplication for pardon, preservation from sin, and divine guidance, are prominent topics. 
 
    1. lift up my soul-- (
), set my affections (compare

entries.title: Psalms 25:2
segments: 2. not be ashamed--by disappointment of hopes of relief.

entries.title: Psalms 25:3
segments: 3. The prayer generalized as to all who wait on God--that is, who expect His favor. On the other hand, the disappointment of the perfidious, who, unprovoked, have done evil, is invoked (compare

entries.title: Psalms 25:4
segments: 4, 5. On the ground of former favor, he invokes divine guidance, according to God's gracious ways of dealing and faithfulness.

entries.title: Psalms 25:6
segments: 6, 7. Confessing past and present sins, he pleads for mercy, not on palliations of sin, but on God's well-known benevolence.

entries.title: Psalms 25:8
segments:
8, 9. upright--acting according to His promise.

    meek--who are penitent. the way--and his way--God's way of providence.

entries.title: Psalms 25:9
segments: 9. in judgment--rightly.

entries.title: Psalms 25:10
segments: 10. paths--similar sense--His modes of dealing (compare

). 
 
    mercy and truth-- (
), God's grace in promising and faithfulness in performing.

entries.title: Psalms 25:11
segments: 11. God's perfections of love, mercy, goodness, and truth are manifested (his name, compare
) in pardoning sin, and the greatness of sin renders pardon more needed.

entries.title: Psalms 25:12
segments: 12, 13. What he asks for himself is the common lot of all the pious.

entries.title: Psalms 25:13
segments: 13. inherit the earth--(compare
). The phrase, alluding to the promise of Canaan, expresses all the blessings included in that promise, temporal as well as spiritual.

entries.title: Psalms 25:14
segments: 14. The reason of the blessing explained--the pious enjoy communion with God (compare
), and, of course, learn His gracious terms of pardon.

entries.title: Psalms 25:15
segments:

entries.title: Psalms 25:21
segments: 21. In conscious innocence of the faults charged by his enemies, he confidently commits his cause to God. Some refer-- integrity, &c.--to God, meaning His covenant faithfulness. This sense, though good, is an unusual application of the terms.

entries.title: Psalms 25:22
segments: 22. Extend these blessings to all Thy people in all their distresses.
